title: PARADISE CAVE AND PHONG NHA CAVE ONE DAY TOUR
summary: This Phong Nha Tour is a perfect one-day adventure to explore the stunning natural wonders of Phong Nha Ke Bang National Park.
inclusions: Round-trip electric car tickets inside Paradise Cave
Round-trip boat tickets on Son River
html:
This Phong Nha Tour is a perfect one-day adventure to explore the stunning natural wonders of Phong Nha Ke Bang National Park.

You will visit Paradise Cave, one of the largest and most spectacular caves in Vietnam, cruise along the scenic Son River, and discover the amazing formations inside Phong Nha Cave.

This tour is ideal for travelers who want to experience the beauty of caves, the local countryside, and enjoy a relaxing day in nature with a professional guide.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – Pick up at the meeting point (Hue or Dong Hoi) by car and tour guide.

Travel to Phong Nha Ke Bang National Park.

09:30 – Visit Paradise Cave.

12:30 – Lunch at a local restaurant, enjoy countryside specialties.

13:30 – Cruise on the Son River.

14:00 – Visit Phong Nha Cave.

17:00 – Return to Dong Hoi City or Hue.

TOUR PRICE

45 US dollars per person.

SERVICES INCLUDED

  • Transportation by air conditioned car

  • Professional tour guide

  • Entrance tickets to all attractions

  • Round-trip electric car tickets inside Paradise Cave

  • Round-trip boat tickets on Son River

  • Lunch at local restaurant

  • Mineral water

  • Hats and helmets
outline: Day 1: PARADISE CAVE AND PHONG NHA CAVE ONE DAY TOUR
